helpful: Full petition and BIO text provisioned under record/documents/ (neither truncated) made the vehicle analysis possible without retrieval.
context.json band + the sal-v4 reached table gave an unambiguous scored anchor.
supremecourt.gov docket HTML via WebFetch was the only source that exposed the companion petition's distribution history.
gaps: Linked/related dockets ('Vide', 'Linked with') are named in the snapshot but not provisioned; the companion's proceedings were the single most informative fact and had to be fetched from the web.
fedcourts query has no topical filter usable on SCOTUS rows (citation column sparse, --topic circuit-only), so no Monell/section-1983 prior set could be retrieved.
CourtListener holds no docket entries for either SCOTUS docket, so the MCP server added nothing beyond a docket id.
A statpack cut conditioned on 'relisted out of the long conference' would be more informative than the terminal relist-count buckets, which the pack notes are diluted by reschedules.
notes: 11 retrieval calls, under the advisory budget. No MCP errors.
